none: PAS HESH-02FED3: Roman patera vessel fragment
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Large fragment from the base of a cast copper alloy vessel, most probably a patera (or pan) of early Roman date (50-150 AD). The fragment comprises the entire base and a small section of the upturned side wall of the vessel.
